generation: Released CLI with a fresh synthetic account and seven signed synthetic events, served by a loopback-only message server in an isolated network namespace. No real account or message data.
sanitization: Copied released database after production writes; deleted non-discovery user rows with secure_delete and VACUUM. Released schema and all public discovery rows and graph bytes preserved. Secret encodings absent.
legacy_graph: nostr-social-graph 0.1.4 binary format 3 stores graph edges and timestamps. It does not store signed head IDs or completeness. Input IDs are an external oracle, not evidence of legacy stored revisions.
scope: Public discovery cache migration, graph adoption and close/reopen only; does not cover pending message delivery or physical upgrade acceptance.
